description: Display a UI for an audio file, providing the user with playback, metadata, and statistics. Use when the user specifically asks to hear or see an audio file, or when otherwise clear from context that one would be helpful.

annotations.description: Optional annotation lanes drawn between the waveform and spectrogram. Each lane has an optional label, optional CSS color, spans [{start,end}] in seconds, and an optional envelope ([{time,value}] with value 0..1) that fades span opacity. Times are in seconds on the audio's own timeline.

annotationsPath.description: Absolute path to a JSON file containing the same { lanes: [...] } structure as `annotations`. Use instead of `annotations` for large payloads. Ignored if `annotations` is also given.

path.description: Absolute path to an audio file on the user's machine

playheadSeconds.description: Optional initial playhead position in seconds (decimal)

region.description: Optional initial selected/highlighted region in seconds (decimal)

name: display_audio_file
title: Display audio file
